title: Physical cash fact is not customer intent and is not Ledger truth
summary: Cash channels preserve separate identities for customer intent, physical custody/device fact and FederationBank monetary truth. Correlation is required; none of the three facts may be silently substituted for another.
invariants: Withdrawal authorisation may place a hold without book movement.
Physical dispense/acceptance is recorded by the physical channel/custody authority before the corresponding commit path claims it happened.
A lost response must never cause a second physical dispense or second Ledger posting.
The terminal/till never supplies an arbitrary internal settlement account.
Already-incurred physical obligations may require explicit mandatory-settlement authority; there is no generic force-post capability.

provenance.claim: ATM physical cash and monetary commit identities are distinct.
Debit authority distinguishes ordinary funds checks from already-incurred mandatory settlement.
